description: Search all of Motory by keyword across used and new cars, offers, the Saudi business directory, news and videos. Takes a keyword, an optional tab and an optional category within it; open a row with the detail endpoint its index_name points to.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description:
**What to search for.** Required; for example `toyota`, `toyota camry`, `spare parts`, or Arabic `تويوتا`.

What the search matches:

- Make names and "make model" phrases in every section, and some other known phrases (for example `electric cars` on `news`).
- In the business directory (`tab=directory`), business names, services (`spare parts`) and make names. A single other known word (for example `golden`), or a service inside a directory `category`, re-orders the whole directory or category by relevance instead of narrowing it; `pagination.total_pages` then stays that of the whole directory or category.
- Other words in a keyword can be ignored without notice: the results are then those of the words that match. For example, on `tab=used_cars` `toyota xyz` and `toyota 2024` return the results for `toyota`, and `mercedes benz` the results for `mercedes`.

Rejected with 400:

- A keyword the search does not recognise at all on the tab (for example `xyzqq`), also within a directory `category`.
- A keyword of digits only (for example `2025`): for model years use `min_year`/`max_year` on `/used-cars` or `/new-cars`.

To filter cars exactly by make and model, take `make_id`/`model_id` from `/search-suggestions` and pass them to `/used-cars` or `/new-cars`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
**Provider name.** Optional; English or Arabic, case-insensitive (for example `ehsan`, `spare parts` or `قطع غيار`).

Matches names that contain the text as written, letters and digits in that order:

- Spaces and hyphens are interchangeable: `al baridi` finds "Al-Baridi Vehicle Inspection Center".
- Other punctuation is ignored: `drmftcars` or `dr.mft.cars` finds "Dr.MFT.Cars".
- Accents are ignored: `e` also finds "é".
- The text can start or stop mid-word: `a` matches every name with an "a".
- Businesses and companies both match. A company name also matches with its punctuation typed as spaces: `s m a al suhaimi` finds "S.M.A Al Suhaimi For Tyres EST".
- A business is found through the name its `link` spells. When several businesses share a name, the `link` of the later ones ends in a number (`-2`, `-3`), so a digit can also find a business whose name has no digit.

For companies only, `/directory-companies` also takes `name`.
